negativeScenarios: callback with another session fails without consuming original state
callback replay and concurrent duplicate permit one exchange only
consent denial consumes state without exchange
provider failure creates no connection and redirects generically
expired session returns 401 with no-store and no-referrer
ciphertext absent from list and provider code absent from redirect
diagnostics: The first broad unit run in a restricted sandbox reported media.test.ts file failure. Its ten cases passed under local process I/O permission, and the complete final 193-case suite passed with zero failed/skipped/cancelled/todo.
The first focused HTTP attempt could not bind local S3Proxy sockets under restricted sandbox; isolated loopback execution passed 2/2, followed by the complete application verifier.
limits: No real Google account, OAuth grant, token or outbound post was used; the provider adapter was replaced only in an isolated HTTP test instance.
The local callback route has no account-connect UI. Refresh rotation, Google revocation, provider receipt/read-only reconciliation, policy, dispatch and scheduler are not wired.
Existing local :id/revoke does not revoke the Google grant.
Final application database is disposable PGlite; native PostgreSQL CI for this new source, native cross-store restore, Compose/MinIO and live/device/master acceptance remain open.
